proposals.rationale: CPR 4.4 exempts an extension or renewal from the 4.3 express-order requirement only if it is consistent with the terms of the contract for the existing Service (4.4.1). proposals.rationale: Clause 4.3 prohibits charging or availing a Service the Subscriber has not expressly ordered or opted to pay for. The facts record no new consent, so the AED 95 charge for a new 7-day period lacks that express order.

Conclusion: CPR 4.4 does not cover the AED 95 extension. Clauses 9.4.2 and 9.4.3 on the Additional Services cap were not supplied, so I flag that the cap position is not assessed here.
